                <div class="eche-officer-question-title-wrapper">
                    <div class="eche-report-title-icons-wrapper">
                                                 <div class="eche-report-officer-number">
                            <img class="eche-report-question-icon" src="https://erasmus-plus.ec.europa.eu/profiles/custom/eac_profile/modules/eac_eche/images/eche-pdf/number-corner-orange-14.png" width="100%" height="100%" alt="Question Icon" title="Question Icon" loading="lazy">

                            <div class="eche-report-officer-number-text">14</div>
                        </div>
                        <div class="eche-officer-question-icon"><img class="eche-report-question-icon" src="https://erasmus-plus.ec.europa.eu/profiles/custom/eac_profile/modules/eac_eche/images/ECHE__OFFICERS_Q14.png" width="100%" height="100%" alt="Question Icon" title="Question Icon" loading="lazy">
</div>
                    </div>
                    <div class="eche-report-title-question-text-wrapper">
                        <div class="eche-officer-question"> With regards to the outcomes and experiences of Erasmus+ activities</div>
                        <div class="eche-report-button-js eche-report-detail-close"><i class="fa fa-plus-circle fa-3x"></i></div>
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div class="eche-officer-question-wrapper eche-report-question-wrapper-show">
                    <div class="eche-report-border"></div>
                    <div classs="eche-officer-must">
                                                <h3>Must have</h3>
                                                <span class="eche-officer-user-answer">The results are monitored, evaluated and disseminated as a way to improve international cooperation and mobility activities</span>
                        <h4>Guidance note:</h4>
                         <p>Linked with the overall internationalisation strategy of the institution, monitoring and evaluation of cooperation projects and Erasmus+ mobility is essential if HEIs are to learn from their experiences. Monitoring and evaluation is more than just measuring the number and types of outputs, it needs to include capturing information on the overall outcomes and experiences of the activities at the institutional and the individual level. Systematic monitoring and evaluation should therefore include more qualitative approaches, which expressly capture the experiences in a way which helps the institution to understand the added value of its involvement in these activities. Documenting and analysing the outcomes and experiences is only the first step. To learn from the approaches taken, and the benefits gained, institutions should take time to disseminate the findings of the cooperation projects and mobility periods through, for example, meetings, workshops and publications, social media, etc. These activities will embed good practice, help the institution to iteratively improve its approach and also feed back into the on-going monitoring and evaluation.</p>                         <span class="eche-officer-user-answer">The results are used systematically for the benefit of your institution, providing internationalisation at home, hence enhancing intercultural competences of non-mobile students and staff</span>
                        <h4>Guidance note:</h4>
                         <p>The outcomes and experiences of cooperation and Erasmus+ mobility have a much wider impact than just improving mobile activities. All institutions have significant numbers of non-mobile staff and students who can benefit from the international experiences of others. As part of the monitoring and evaluation processes, HEIs should consider the impact which can be specifically made on non-mobile staff and students, giving them “internationalisation at home experiences”. This includes building international competences, cultural awareness, virtual mobility opportunities, inviting international lecturers and embedding student projects with an international focus into the curricula, and providing opportunities for local students to work together with incoming mobile participants in e.g. project work, to ensure that local students benefit from the presence of mobile students at their institution. This fits with the activities of disseminating the overall outcomes and experiences of the cooperation projects and Erasmus+ mobility, though tailored to a different audience. It should take into account the professional development needs of the staff at the HEI and the perspectives of non-mobile students.&nbsp;</p>                      </div>
                    <div class="eche-officer-best">
                                                <h3>Best practices</h3>

                         <p>The dissemination of outcomes is an integral part of mobility projects. In order to do this, HEIs should provide support functions such as web platforms to collect results or opportunities to present results at the institutional or departmental level, as relevant.&nbsp;</p>                         <span class="eche-officer-user-answer">After the mobility Erasmus+ participants have the opportunity to present their newly acquired competences</span>

                         <p>The study entitled ‘Effects of mobility on the skills and employability of students and the internationalisation of higher education institutions’ showcases how mobility can contribute to the internationalisation of higher education institutions, including the impacts on teaching methods, cooperation between HEIs and perception of staff more generally. Therefore the dissemination of outcomes is an integral part of mobility projects. Dein Extra

  • Eine Kooperation mit Urban Sports Club, Jobrad sowie weiteren Partnern zu attraktiven Firmenkonditionen, damit du fit für den Job bleibst.

AMPECO is one of the most innovative companies in the area of electric vehicle charging infrastructure – an industry that aims to change the world by making charging easier for everyone. As electric vehicles (EVs) are bringing in a transformation of our transport and mobility sectors, AMPECO is at the forefront of a grand revolution and we’re just getting started.

Our product – the AMPECO EV Charging Platform is a business-critical SaaS platform used by companies to manage their electric vehicle charging infrastructure, processes and energy use. It’s already in use by companies in more than 70 countries — across North and South America, Europe, Africa, Asia and Australia.

Our team is highly motivated, capable, and committed to our mission — and our growth is backed by world-class investors, including BMW i Ventures, the mobility-focused venture-capital arm of the BMW Group. We are looking to expand the team with like-minded capable people, eager to give, learn and grow together with us.

About the role

AMPECO is expanding across the DACH region, and we’re looking for a Germany-based Senior Solution Consultant - responsible for pre-sales across Germany, Austria, and Switzerland - to help drive that growth. This is a senior, individual-contributor role for someone who combines deep product and industry expertise with the interpersonal range to win the confidence of technical and business stakeholders alike.

You will be the solutioning counterpart to our DACH Business Development Manager - the two of you working as a close-knit team on the region’s most important opportunities. While the BDM leads the commercial relationship, you own the solution end to end: mapping each prospect’s business needs to AMPECO’s platform, leading demonstrations and Proof-of-Concept engagements, owning bid management for DACH opportunities — from RFx and tenders through to the supporting business case — and making the complex feel clear for everyone in the room.

You won’t be doing this alone. You’ll be enabled by an established Solution Consulting team, with proven tools, practices, and methodologies behind you — so you can put your energy into the deals in front of you. AMPECO already powers some of the most prominent Charge Point Operators in the DACH region and is in active conversations with many of the rest, so you’ll be joining at a moment of real momentum and clear opportunity to expand. As we continue to grow across Germany and the wider region, the impact you make here will be significant — with room to grow alongside it.

If you thrive in fast-paced, complex enterprise environments, enjoy working with highly driven teams, and want to play a pivotal role in the energy transition in one of Europe’s most important EV markets, this role is for you.


Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain in-depth knowledge of AMPECO’s platform and the e-mobility industry, with a strong grasp of the DACH market and its requirements;

  • Act as the solutioning lead on strategic DACH opportunities, working hand in hand with the DACH Business Development Manager to map each prospect’s business needs to AMPECO’s capabilities;

  • Drive Proof-of-Concept engagements with prospective clients, ensuring the business drivers are sound, relevant, and build a compelling case to advance the opportunity;

  • Design and deliver effective demonstrations that connect AMPECO’s solution advantages to prospects’ business and technical requirements;

  • Build and maintain trusted relationships with the key stakeholders involved in DACH deals, becoming a credible advisor throughout the sales cycle;

  • Take an active advisory role during sales cycles, bringing solution expertise and industry best practices to the team;

  • Own bid management for DACH opportunities — taking end-to-end responsibility for RFIs, RFPs, RFQs, and tenders, from structuring and writing the response to coordinating input across teams and managing deadlines;

  • Represent AMPECO at industry events across the region and stay close to market trends, the competitive landscape, and evolving customer needs;

  • Travel across the DACH region as needed for customer engagements, workshops, and events.


    • Your Profile

  • 6+ years of professional experience, including 3+ years in a pre-sales, solution consulting, or similar sales-focused role within enterprise or B2B software;

  • Native-level German and fluent English, both spoken and written — you will work with German-speaking enterprise customers daily;

  • Strong pre-sales execution skills: solution design, demonstrations, Proof-of-Concepts, and bid / RFx management;

  • Tech-savvy and a fast learner on technical topics — comfortable holding technical conversations and explaining how the platform works, without needing to be a deeply technical specialist or engineer;

  • A confident communicator, able to build rapport and credibility with senior business and technical stakeholders and to present complex topics clearly;

  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to structure complex challenges and shape solutions for evolving business models;

  • Strong business acumen — able to articulate customer value and connect AMPECO’s platform to strategic outcomes;

  • Based in Germany, self-driven and well-organised, and comfortable operating effectively in a remote, distributed team across the DACH region;

  • Naturally curious, with a genuine interest in continuously learning about the product and the industry;

  • A collaborative team player who works seamlessly with Sales, Product, and other specialists;

  • Motivated to build a long-term career in the e-mobility sector.


    • Considered an advantage

  • Domain knowledge in mobility, energy, or a related sector;

  • Familiarity with EV charging technology and standards such as OCPP, OCPI, or ISO 15118;

  • Experience working in a SaaS or PaaS environment with long, multi-stakeholder enterprise sales cycles;

  • Background in consulting or professional services;

  • Experience in enterprise sales;

  • Fluency in an additional European language (e.g. French, Italian).


    • What we offer
  • Competitive salary and benefits package;
  • Flexibility to work from anywhere in Germany or from a modern co-working space in Munich's Werksviertel, near Ostbahnhof;
  • Opportunity to grow with a mission-driven startup in a high-impact industry.

    Your responsibilities

    The Spinning Disk Confocal Specialist role requires that you work closely together with the European Life Science Sales Teams (Territory Managers and Senior Sales Specialists). You are responsible for supporting the direct sales team and distributors in driving the sales process for our spinning disk confocal systems, alongside other high-end life science microscopy systems, in your territory (primarily Germany, Austria, Switzerland and Eastern Central Europe), covering both direct and indirect sales. During the sales process you will have meetings with customers to present our product portfolio, and you will organize and perform in a convincing way onsite system demonstrations as well as remote demonstrations, providing your expert knowledge to solve customers’ applications and issues.     • Due to the territory, you will be responsible for, you ideally live in Germany or Austria, with good connection possibilities to highways, train stations and airports.

    • Class B driver's license is mandatory.

    • Home Office based worker.

    The following activities – among others – will help you to achieve your goals:

    • Supporting the direct sales team and distribution partners in driving the sales process for our spinning disk confocal solutions in your territory.

    • Supporting and developing distribution partners in your territory, including joint customer visits, demonstrations and product training.

    • Enabling distribution partners to position our systems competitively, and holding regular joint pipeline reviews with them and the direct sales team.

    • Managing, organizing and conducting all customer touch points during the sales process (incl. for example customer meetings, system demonstrations, workshops, closing meetings etc.). You will be travelling approximately 60% of your time, primarily within your territory.

    • Cooperating in a very close way with senior sales specialists and other sales and application specialists in Europe, especially for your demo and workshop activities.

    • Providing help to colleagues outside your territory, including opportunities across EMEA, depending on your expertise and business needs.

    • Conducting lectures and training at customer events.

    • Participating in local exhibitions.

    • Observing and analyzing the market and deducting an action plan for your territory with the goal to increase market share.

    • Positioning our systems against competing platforms in customer evaluations and head-to-head demonstrations, with the aim of winning competitive opportunities.

    • Tracking competitor products, pricing and customer wins and losses, and feeding these insights back to Sales Management, Marketing and Product Management.

    • Gather best-practice cases and actively share experiences and knowledge within the Advanced Life Science Systems sales team.

    • Supporting the Marketing team and Sales Management in collecting testimonials, image materials, application notes, etc. from your customers, and using them as proof points to show where our systems outperform the competition.

    AI is changing how software gets built. Code production is becoming a commodity. The focus is shifting from writing code to specifying, orchestrating, verifying, and governing change, and the toolchain is the new constraint.

    About the Team

    • Create reusable architectures, tooling, playbooks, and technical guidance that accelerate future enterprise deployments.

IonQ is making quantum platforms more accessible and impactful than ever before.  </p></div><p><strong>Location:</strong> Oxford, England<br><strong>Travel:</strong> As needed<strong><br>Job ID:</strong> 1905</p> <p><strong>The Role:<br></strong></p> <p>We are looking for a Technical Programme Manager to join the Quantum Systems Infrastructure (QSI) team at IonQ's Oxford office. QSI builds and runs the platform our next-generation quantum computers are built, tested, released and operated on, from bare metal in the lab to cloud, working across both Oxford and the US.</p> <p>Your mission is to run the machinery that keeps QSI’s portfolio visible, planned and unblocked so engineers can engineer, leaders can lead, and the business always knows what is changing and why it matters. You will work very closely with the Technical Programme Managers in the Software and Science teams, ensuring our processes and workflows complement and integrate with their work, rather than duplicating effort. </p> <p>We run a centralised PMO operating model at IonQ which you will be a core part of though on a day to day basis you will work alongside the QSI team. As part of this model, this role will not make technical decisions, own engineering headcount, or define product but it will make the programme around those things run.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>Responsibilities</strong>:</p> <p>You will own programme execution across QSI’s delivery streams, translating a leadership-visible roadmap into clear plans, measurable milestones and predictable delivery. You will create and run the operating rhythm that keeps teams aligned and leaders informed. When priorities shift, you will implement structure to that ambiguity, clarifying scope, coordinating trade-offs and pushing problems to resolution.</p> <p>Key responsibilities include:</p> <ul> <li>Owning programme execution across QSI’s delivery streams: one planning rhythm, one backlog discipline, ensuring dependencies and risks surfaced early and chased to resolution.</li> <li>Running the roadmap-to-delivery link: keeping the roadmap, Jira and reality agreeing with each other, and making slippage visible early.</li> <li>Owning the programme ceremonies and the design of the workflows behind them (day-to-day stand-ups are run by the engineering managers).</li> <li>Working hand-in-hand with the Software and Science TPMs: shared or integrated processes wherever teams interact, and no duplicated ceremonies, boards or reporting.</li> <li>Coordinating across teams - Continuing Engineering (US), the PMO, product and science teams - serving as QSI’s cross-functional programme liaison.</li> <li>Establishing programme cadences and reporting (changelogs, demos, leadership summaries etc) in plain English that non-infrastructure stakeholders can read and trust.</li> <li>Running the intake and triage process so requests reach the right stream with the right priority, without engineers being interrupt-driven.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>Requirements:</strong></p> <p>We’re looking for a technically fluent Programme Manager who brings structure, pace and clarity to a fast-moving infrastructure organisation. You will be comfortable working in a deeply technical environment, working daily with platform and systems engineers, while translating progress, risks and trade-offs into clear reporting senior stakeholders can trust. You will thrive in ambiguity and an organisation where you are able to drive change. You do not just coordinate: you unblock teams, keep plans honest, and raise the bar on how programmes are run.</p> <p>You will have prior experience tunning technical programmes across multiple engineering teams, ideally in infrastructure, platform or systems engineering environments. You should be fluent with modern programme tooling, such as Jira, Confluence and GitHub, and have the judgement to keep process lightweight.</p> <p>You’d be a great fit with:</p> <ul> <li>Experience harmonising ways of working across sibling teams or departments, integrating processes rather than multiplying them.</li> <li>Strong, plain-English communication and the ability to make infrastructure work legible to non-technical stakeholders.</li> <li>Ability to manage multiple workstreams simultaneously across sites and time zones in a fast-paced, changing environment.</li> <li>A chase-without-nagging, escalate-without-drama working style, and a clear sense of the difference between a risk and a noise.</li> </ul> <p>Additional experience would be beneficial, such as a background in hardware-adjacent software (labs, manufacturing, robotics, scientific instruments), exposure to regulated or government-customer delivery, or agile coaching / scrum mastery experience. Working knowledge of quantum computing concepts would be a plus though is not essential.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>Benefits:</strong></p> <p>Be part of a team that’s shaping the future of quantum. We offer more than just a role, you’ll join a world class community of scientists, engineers and innovators working to unlock the full potential of quantum computing.</p> <p>We offer a range of benefits, including opportunities to further your career alongside industry leaders, a competitive salary with IonQ stock options, an annual performance bonus, generous annual leave, flexible hybrid working, private medical and dental insurance for you and your family, and much more.</p> <p>Join us and be part of the future of quantum computing.</p> <p>We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p>Compensation will vary based on individual factors such as education, qualifications, and experience of the final candidate(s), specific office location, and calibration against relevant market data and internal team equity. Posted base salary figures are subject to change as new market data becomes available. Our benefits include comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plans, matching 401(k), unlimited PTO and paid holidays, parental/adoption leave, legal insurance, and a home technology stipend. Details of participation in these benefit plans will be provided when a candidate receives an offer of employment. </p> <p>At IonQ, we believe in fair treatment, access, opportunity, and advancement for all while striving to identify and eliminate barriers. We empower employees to thrive by fostering a culture of autonomy, productivity, and respect. We are dedicated to creating an environment where individuals can feel welcomed, respected, supported, and valued.<br> <br>We are committed to equity and justice. We welcome different voices and viewpoints and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, ancestry, physical and/or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, age, sexual orientation, military or veteran status, or any other basis protected by law. We are proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>US Technical Jobs. </strong>The position you are applying for will require access to technology that is subject to U.S. export control and government contract restrictions.  Employment with IonQ is contingent on either verifying “U.S. Person” (e.g., U.S. citizen, U.S. national, U.S. permanent resident, or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum) status for export controls and government contracts work, obtaining any necessary license, and/or confirming the availability of a license exception under U.S. export controls.  Please note that in the absence of confirming you are a U.S. Person for export control and government contracts work purposes, IonQ may choose not to apply for a license or decline to use a license exception (if available) for you to access export-controlled technology that may require authorization, and similarly, you may not qualify for government contracts work that requires U.S. Persons, and IonQ may decline to proceed with your application on those bases alone.  Accordingly, we will have some additional questions regarding your immigration status that will be used for export control and compliance purposes, and the answers will be reviewed by compliance personnel to ensure compliance with federal law.  </p> <p><strong>US Non-Technical Jobs. </strong>Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum. Accordingly, we will have some additional questions regarding your immigration status that will be used for export control and compliance purposes, and the answers will be reviewed by compliance personnel to ensure compliance with federal law.</p> <p> </p> <p>If you are interested in being a part of our team and mission, we encourage you to apply! </p></div>

    About 3E:

    3E is a mission-driven company dedicated to creating a safer and more sustainable world. We offer award-winning regulatory intelligence and AI solutions to help organizations protect people and products. With over 35 years of experience and a global presence, we empower our customers with innovative compliance solutions. 

    You will get to work at a company that combines startup agility with the stability of an industry leader. Partner with enterprise customers and global experts to advance environmental safety and solve complex data science challenges.

    Join us and make an impact!

    About the Role

    As an Implementation Project Manager at 3E, you’ll lead larger, more complex customer implementations where successful delivery requires multiple products, technical contributors, workstreams, dependencies, and stakeholders to operate against one coordinated plan.

    You’ll be accountable for turning the customer’s scope of work into an executable implementation strategy and for determining whether the overall project succeeds—on time, within scope, adopted, and connected to a clear customer outcome. You’ll establish success and acceptance criteria, own the integrated project plan, manage risk and change, coordinate specialists and technical teams, and give both customers and 3E leadership a clear, data-backed view of project health.

    You’ll understand the technical delivery deeply enough to challenge assumptions, identify dependencies, connect customer needs with the right specialists, and engage credibly with Product and Engineering. You won’t need to personally execute every configuration, migration, or integration; your role is to ensure those pieces come together into a successful customer outcome.

    What You’ll Do

    • Lead complex new-logo, cross-sell, and Value Realization implementations from internal handoff through customer acceptance and formal close.

    • Translate complex scopes of work into an integrated delivery strategy covering products, workstreams, milestones, resources, dependencies, assumptions, exclusions, and acceptance criteria.

    • Lead technical discovery and pre-integration planning with customers, CX technical specialists, and relevant internal teams.

    • Own the master implementation plan and coordinate implementation specialists, Product, Engineering, Data, Cloud, technical consultants, external partners, and customer resources.

    • Establish measurable success and acceptance criteria at kickoff and maintain accountability for those outcomes throughout delivery.

    • Lead customer project governance, including senior stakeholder and sponsor communications.

    • Maintain the milestone tracker and conduct phase-gate reviews, giving a clear assessment of whether projects are on track, at risk, or behind and establishing mitigation plans when required.

    • Identify cross-workstream dependencies and risks early and determine their impact on the critical path.

    • Lead complex, multi-product delivery by managing scope and change control, coordinating custom development through launch, maintaining a unified customer plan across teams, and providing leadership with clear, data-backed reporting on project health, risk, timelines, value, and adoption.

    • Build and maintain dashboards or reporting tools that make project status and risks visible without relying solely on status meetings.

    • Lead customer escalations diplomatically while maintaining accountability for customer commitments, decisions, resources, data readiness, and signoffs.

    • Partner with Commercial on implementation handoff and identify expansion opportunities or renewal risks surfaced during delivery.

    • Represent the delivery perspective during pre-sales scoping of complex or higher-risk opportunities so commitments can be successfully delivered.

    • Drive structured post-onboarding Value Realization Projects, including complex migrations, integrations, optimization, remediation, and workflow initiatives.

    • Manage multiple concurrent implementations and make prioritization decisions based on risk, complexity, dependencies, and customer impact.

    • Identify opportunities to improve implementation processes, delivery predictability, time-to-value, and the overall customer experience.

    What Makes You a Great Fit

    Required

    • 3–5 years of experience in software implementation, customer onboarding, technical account or project management, or professional services, ideally within B2B SaaS, technology, or information services.

    • Demonstrated experience leading complex customer implementations with multiple workstreams, technical dependencies, contributors, or products.

    • Experience owning project scope, plans, milestones, risks, dependencies, change control, customer communication, and delivery outcomes.

    • Strong technical aptitude and the ability to understand configuration, data, integration, and technical delivery sufficiently to coordinate specialists and identify risk; coding is not required.

    • Demonstrated ability to lead customer conversations and communicate credibly with senior customer stakeholders.

    • Ability to lead and influence cross-functional contributors without formal authority.

    • Experience managing multiple concurrent projects and making informed prioritization decisions based on customer and business impact.

    • Strong written and verbal communication, analytical thinking, judgment, and problem-solving skills.

    • Proficiency with CRM tools such as Salesforce or HubSpot and Microsoft Office, with comfort using data, dashboards, and systems of record to communicate project health.

    • Ability to navigate ambiguity and changing scope while maintaining accountability for outcomes.

    • Willingness to travel 10–20%.

    Preferred

    • Bachelor’s degree in business, information systems, environmental science, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

    • Experience with enterprise and/or mid-market SaaS customers.

    • Experience developing or improving implementation processes and customer journeys.

    • Familiarity with implementation, onboarding, or enablement tools such as Pendo, Gong, or Zendesk.

    • Experience working with time-to-value, adoption, usage, or customer health metrics.

    • Exposure to environmental, regulatory, compliance, chemical management, SDS, EHS, or sustainability software.

    • Multilingual capability and/or experience supporting global customers.

    About 3E:

    3E is a mission-driven company dedicated to creating a safer and more sustainable world. We offer award-winning regulatory intelligence and AI solutions to help organizations protect people and products. With over 35 years of experience and a global presence, we empower our customers with innovative compliance solutions. 

    You will get to work at a company that combines startup agility with the stability of an industry leader. Partner with enterprise customers and global experts to advance environmental safety and solve complex data science challenges.

    Join us and make an impact!

    About the Role

    As an Implementation Specialist at 3E, you’ll turn a signed customer contract into a working, adopted solution. You’ll own hands-on implementation activities from kickoff through configuration, validation, foundational training, launch, and handoff—helping customers reach measurable first value from 3E’s products.

    This role combines technical implementation, customer engagement, and project coordination. You’ll translate the agreed scope of work into a practical delivery plan, configure customer environments using real customer data, coordinate with technical and cross-functional partners, and keep milestones, risks, dependencies, and customer commitments visible throughout the engagement.

    You’ll also support post-onboarding Value Realization Projects that help customers expand or improve their use of 3E through activities such as migrations, integrations, data remediation, inventory and catalog optimization, and workflow enablement.

    You’ll work closely with the broader account team with clear ownership: the Implementation Specialist owns implementation delivery, the CSM owns ongoing adoption, and the AM owns the commercial account.

    This role is well suited to someone who enjoys combining hands-on technical work with customer interaction, takes ownership of outcomes, and is comfortable working through changing priorities and ambiguity. Those characteristics also connect authentically with 3E's broader EVP around building, operating through ambiguity, and moving between planning and execution.

    Location: This position supports remote work within the UK.

    What You’ll Do

    • Lead assigned customer implementations from internal handoff and kickoff through configuration, validation, foundational training, launch, and formal handoff.

    • Conduct implementation discovery and help confirm customer data readiness, environment requirements, security considerations, and integration prerequisites.

    • Translate the scope of work into a documented implementation plan with milestones, deliverables, dependencies, assumptions, and customer responsibilities.

    • Configure 3E customer environments, including inventory and structure, users and roles, integrations, and core workflows aligned with customer goals.

    • Work directly with customer contacts and administrators to validate the solution and deliver foundational training.

    • Coordinate with Product, Engineering, Data, Cloud, technical specialists, and external implementation partners as required for delivery.

    • Track milestones and identify risks, dependencies, or potential scope changes early.

    • Follow established change-control processes when customer requests extend beyond the agreed scope.

    • Hold customers accountable for implementation commitments such as data readiness, resourcing, testing, and sign-offs.

    • Execute post-onboarding Value Realization Projects such as migrations, data remediation, integrations, inventory optimization, and workflow enablement.

    • Maintain accurate project records and documented handoffs while managing multiple concurrent implementations, keeping status, configuration, outcomes, risks, next steps, and training needs visible and prioritizing work based on customer impact, project risk, and key milestones.

    • Build technical proficiency across 3E products and work credibly with technical teams to troubleshoot implementation issues and identify risks; coding is not required.

    • Surface customer-identified bugs, product issues, and feature requests to the appropriate internal teams.

    What Makes You a Great Fit

    Required

    • 2-3 years of experience in software implementation, customer onboarding, technical account or project management, or professional services, ideally within B2B SaaS, technology, or information services.

    • Strong technical aptitude with demonstrated ability to configure software, troubleshoot setup issues, and learn new products.

    • Experience managing multiple concurrent customer projects or implementations to deadlines and measurable outcomes.

    • Ability to translate customer requirements and agreed scope into clear implementation activities, milestones, and deliverables.

Who We Are

Great Minds is a high-growth, mission-driven organization founded by educators in 2007. As a for-profit, Public Benefit Corporation, we believe all students deserve access to meaningful, challenging content—and all teachers deserve tools that are intuitive, effective, and built for the realities of today’s classrooms.

We develop high-quality, knowledge-rich math, science and ELA curricula grounded in research and designed in collaboration with educators. Our materials reflect real classroom needs and are built to drive lasting student outcomes.

We are committed to usability, coherence, and practical implementation—supporting teachers not just through curriculum, but with professional learning, purposeful technology, and responsive service that enable strong adoption and impact.

What We Build

Our products—Eureka Math and Eureka Math², Wit & Wisdom, PhD Science, Geodes, and the newly launched Arts & Letters ELA—are trusted by thousands of schools and districts nationwide.

  • Eureka Math is the most widely used math curriculum in the U.S., and is focused on balancing conceptual understanding, procedural fluency, and application.

  • Wit & Wisdom® and Arts & Letters ELA™ anchor our reading strategy with content-rich, grade-level instruction that integrates literature, history, and the arts, grounded in the science of reading. Geodes® complements our reading suite with decodable texts that pair phonics with meaningful content to support early literacy.

These programs reflect a shared belief in high expectations, joyful rigor, and deep respect for educators and students.

Where We’re Headed

Great Minds is entering a new stage of growth and product maturity. We are focused on building more connected, customer-informed experiences across the full educator journey—from curriculum to professional learning to platform and support.

Our long-term vision is to become a true partner in impact—not just delivering curriculum, but supporting educators in achieving outcomes at scale.


Job Purpose
The PD Associate is a member of the Implementation Services team and supports Great Minds in its mission to promote adoption and effective implementation of all curriculum products. Maintaining intimate knowledge of the features and advantages of Great Minds products and services, PD Associates work as part of a regional team to support districts and schools to successfully implement Great Minds curriculum. The PD Associate is a versatile, part-time team member with the skills to deliver a blend of services that include both PD facilitation and coaching.

This role is an exceptional opportunity for skilled teachers or instructional coaches who are experienced in implementing a high-quality curriculum to contribute to Great Minds’ organizational mission to ensure all students have access to a high-quality, knowledge-based education.


Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain expertise in the Great Minds professional services catalog in order to provide high-quality, on-site support, coaching, and PD to assigned schools

  • Engage in cycles of internal training to develop or deepen expertise in new professional services offerings, in general facilitation and coaching skills, and to gain greater familiarity with Great Minds products

  • Cultivate and maintain a strong and supportive Great Minds culture in all work environments, with an emphasis on trust, collegiality, curiosity, and quality

Requirements

Requirements

  • At least 3 years of experience teaching or coaching with at least 1 year of experience delivering high-quality professional development.

  • Experience implementing one of Great Minds curricula, especially Wit & Wisdom and/or Eureka Math

  • Proficiency with or alignment to Great Minds instructional design and pedagogy

  • Deep content knowledge in the curriculum focus area (humanities, mathematics, science)

  • Experience with both digital and print education platforms

  • Strong organizational habits necessary for successful goal setting, project management, collective decision making, deadline execution, and record keeping

  • Ability to make solutions-oriented decisions through flexible thinking in an ambiguous, fast-paced entrepreneurial environment

Attributes

  • Passion for and commitment to the importance of high-quality, knowledge-rich curriculum

  • Commitment to high standards, instructional quality, and continuous improvement for oneself and others

  • Receptivity to feedback with a focus on reflective practice

  • Highly collaborative with the ability to consistently exhibit diplomacy, tact, and integrity

  • Appreciation for the challenges and victories faced everyday by educators and their leaders working toward improving student learning outcomes

  • Empathy, curiosity, and the desire to continually grow as a learner

  • Deep belief that every child is capable of greatness

Required Education

  • Bachelor's degree

Status

  • Part-time

  • Remote

Location

Candidates should be located in the Western US

(New Mexico, Arizona, California, Oregon, Washington, Nevada, Utah, Wyoming, Idaho, Montana)

Travel

The PD Associate will provide onsite PD or coaching with occasional virtual sessions. Based on the regional needs across Great Minds, occasional travel beyondthis region is possible.

A valid driver’s license and willingness to fly and drive are required for this position.

The hourly rate for this position is $34/hr - $45/hr. Final hourly rate will be based on the candidate’s geographic location.

A cover letter and resume are required to be considered for this position.

New employees will be required to successfully complete a background check and provide declaration of COVID-19 vaccination status. We do not require COVID-19 vaccination as a condition of employment; however, your vaccination status could impact your ability to perform this role at certain client sites.

Job Description

The Senior Recruiter is responsible for managing the full-cycle recruitment process for assigned business units, ensuring the timely attraction, assessment, and hiring of qualified talent. Job Advert

Reward Partner

Fixed-Term Contract (9 months)

Part-time - 22.5 to 30 hours per week

Home based, with occasional travel to London and Ramsay hospital sites



The Role

We have a great opportunity for an experienced Reward professional to join Ramsay Health Care UK as an Reward Partner on a 9-month fixed-term contract.


Reporting to the Head of Reward, you’ll play an important role in delivering our Reward agenda across Ramsay UK, taking ownership of key annual reward activities and supporting a range of compensation, benefits and reward projects.


This is a broad and hands-on role requiring someone who can quickly build relationships, confidently work with stakeholders across the organisation and manage several priorities at once. You’ll also provide leadership and support to our Reward Advisor, helping the team continue to deliver a great service to our people.


You’ll be involved in:

  • Supporting the delivery of our annual pay review, including planning, stakeholder engagement, communications and manager training
  • Leading our annual benefits enrolment window through the Ramsay BAR Employee Benefits Platform
  • Delivering our Buy/Sell Annual Leave programme
  • Supporting our Job Evaluation project alongside our external Reward Consultant
  • Leading and supporting wider reward, compensation and benefits projects
  • Providing trusted advice and guidance on reward matters to colleagues across the business
  • Keeping our reward policies, guidance and resources accurate, relevant and accessible
  • Helping colleagues understand and make the most of the benefits available to them
  • Coaching and supporting the Reward Advisor and ensuring a high-quality service from the Reward team

What we’re looking for

We’re looking for an experienced Reward professional who combines strong technical knowledge with a practical, collaborative approach.


To be successful in the role, you’ll ideally bring:


  • Significant experience working within Reward, compensation and benefits
  • Strong knowledge of compensation and employee benefits
  • Previous experience of managing, coaching or developing others
  • Experience delivering annual reward cycles and managing reward projects
  • Excellent analytical and numerical skills with strong attention to detail
  • The ability to build credibility and influence stakeholders at different levels
  • Strong organisation and project management skills, with the ability to work to challenging deadlines
  • A commercial and pragmatic approach to problem solving
  • Strong Excel and Microsoft Office capability
  • The ability to interpret data and turn insight into practical recommendations

Experience of Workday, particularly Advanced Compensation, job evaluation programmes or membership of REBA or similar professional networks would be advantageous.


And in return?


In return for your commitment and expertise, Ramsay offers a comprehensive benefits package including:


  • 25 days' annual leave plus bank holidays, pro-rated
  • Buy and sell annual leave options
  • Private pension with Ramsay matching contributions up to 5% after a qualifying period
  • Enhanced parental leave policies
  • Private medical cover, with the option to add a partner and dependants
  • Life assurance at three times base salary
  • Training and development through the Ramsay Academy
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Cycle2Work scheme in partnership with Halfords
  • Blue Light Card eligibility

You'll also be joining an organisation where reward has a real part to play in how we attract, recognise and retain great people.


About us

Ramsay Health Care UK is one of the leading providers of independent hospital services in England and is part of the global Ramsay Health Care organisation.


At Ramsay, our people are our greatest asset. Our culture is built around a simple but powerful idea: People Caring for People.


The Ramsay Way shapes how we work together every day. We build strong relationships, seek to grow sustainably and constantly look for ways to improve. We value people with a positive, "can do" approach who want to make a difference for our colleagues, patients and communities.

Next Steps

If you're an experienced Reward professional looking for an opportunity where you can quickly make an impact, work on some important reward initiatives and join a supportive team, we'd love to hear from you.


We are committed to equality of opportunity for all and welcome applications from a diverse range of candidates.


We care. It’s more than what we do, it’s who we are. Everything we do is about striving to deliver the best care. And it's a belief that's as true today as it was when we welcomed our first patients in 1964. “The Ramsay Way” culture recognises that our people are our most important asset and this has been key to our ongoing success.

We are committed to equality of opportunity for all. This position is subject to background and DBS checks.

We are proud to support the UK’s Armed Forces and Reservists and have already achieved the Silver Award as part of the MOD’s Armed Forces Covenant Employer Recognition Scheme. The scheme recognises employers who actively support Defence while encouraging other organisations to adopt the same behaviours in their workplace. As a company we are committed to supporting the wider Armed Forces community and this includes our staff as well as our patients.

We are committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of adults, children and young people at risk. We expect all employees to share this commitment and behave in a way that supports it. All successful candidates will be provided with safeguarding training appropriate to their role.

Job summary

We are seeking a Senior Manager to join our Integrated Kidney Care (IKC) Revenue Analytics team, which is responsible for all CMS risk adjustment-related analytics. This role will lead the financial and strategic aspects of risk adjustment, providing actionable insights that inform executive-level decision-making. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in analytics, finance, and risk adjustment, with the ability to translate complex data into strategic recommendations. This is an exciting opportunity to shape the direction of risk adjustment analytics within a dynamic and growing organization.

Essential responsibilities:

  • Provide strategic leadership and management for the IKC Risk Adjustment Accuracy
  • Create and maintain leadership reports on IKC revenue financials and estimating impact IKC initiatives had on Medical Loss Ratio (MLR)

For nearly 20 years, TheKey has helped clients achieve successful long-term aging at home with comprehensive, concierge-based care. Ensuring the dignity, safety, and independence of its clients, TheKey is committed to changing how the world lives and ages at home. Employee-teams get the training, resources, and support they need to deliver an exceptional care experience for clients and their families. Founded in Silicon Valley, TheKey has grown from a single location to service coverage throughout North America enabling clients to live life on their own terms, in their own homes.

Who We Are

TheKey is led by a team that reflects a wide range of industry experience in home care, senior care, and healthcare, along with deep expertise in technology, operations, transformation, and customer experience. This includes guidance from our Scientific Advisory Board, made up of nine experts in brain health, aging, and geriatrics, alongside the day-to-day expertise of our clinical and care teams who bring this work to life in the home. But what unites everyone at TheKey, from our leadership team to our caregivers, is a shared passion for reimagining what aging at home can look like. We're driven by a common mission: helping more older adults get the services and tools they need to age well, where and how they want.

The Role

The Director of FP&A acts as a strategic architect and financial heartbeat for the business, translating high-level goals into actionable, data-driven plans. Beyond managing core budgeting, forecasting, and board-level reporting, this role serves as a trusted advisor to leadership—challenging assumptions, identifying risks, and sharpening the rigor of investment decisions. By championing process improvements, fostering team development, and spearheading the integration of AI-enabled analytics, you’ll drive the operational discipline and cross-functional accountability needed to achieve meaningful business outcomes.

The Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate is a seasoned financial leader who blends deep analytical rigor with a collaborative, strategic mindset. You possess 10–15 years of finance experience, with a proven track record in FP&A leadership, team management, and navigating the complexities of board or sponsor reporting. More than just a numbers expert, you are a forward-thinking advisor—proficient in EPM platforms, Excel, and emerging AI tools—who thrives on implementing automation and scalable systems to drive efficiency. Whether you're partnering with executives to shape business decisions, identifying risks, or mentoring analysts to raise the bar on performance, you bring the rare ability to translate high-level strategy into actionable results, ideally complemented by an MBA or CPA and experience within a private equity-backed or multi-site healthcare environment.

Director of FP&A Requirements:

  • Planning and forecasting. Own budgeting, forecasting, and performance reporting for the assigned area.

  • Business cases and capital. Lead investment evaluation and prioritization for assigned areas, sharpening the rigor of business cases supporting proposed spend.

  • Risk and controls. Identify risks and opportunities and drive their resolution. Partner with the VP, FP&A on liquidity forecasting, cash flow planning, and covenant compliance.

  • KPIs and performance. Define KPIs and reporting structure for the area. Own the EBITDA expansion tracker and improve its accuracy, speed, and analytical depth.

  • Business partnering. Partner closely with business leaders, challenging assumptions, shaping decisions, and driving accountability for results.

  • Board and sponsor reporting. Own board and sponsor reporting for the area, supporting audit readiness and the integrity of the underlying data.

  • Tools and automation. Implement finance tools, automation, and process improvements.

  • People leadership. Develop managers and analysts, raising the standard of analytical rigor and communication.

  • Finance systems and data governance. Own planning infrastructure, reporting standards, and finance data quality, ensuring systems support scalable planning and decision-making.

  • Cross-functional execution. Drive cross-functional execution across the business in support of financial targets.

  • AI strategy and enablement. Drive the adoption of AI-enabled planning, reporting, and analytical capabilities, and establish standards for their responsible and effective use.

  • Executive partnership. Serve as a trusted advisor to executive leaders, influencing decisions through financial insight, scenario analysis, and resource allocation recommendations.

  • Strategic planning. Translate company objectives into actionable operating plans and measurable financial targets.

Qualifications & Experience:

  • B.A. or B.S. in finance, accounting, economics, or a related field.

  • Ten to fifteen years of experience in finance, including several years in FP&A leadership, with prior team leadership and board or sponsor exposure.

  • Advanced proficiency in Excel. Experience with EPM and BI platforms.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • MBA or CPA.

  • Experience within a private equity-backed organization. Experience in home care or multi-site healthcare services.

  • Experience with Workday Adaptive Planning. Experience using AI-enabled productivity, reporting, or analytical tools.

Physical Requirements:

Location: within European time zones.

About Pet Media Group

Pet Media Group (PMG) acquires, launches and develops leading pet and equestrian marketplaces around the world. We operate eight brands across seven markets in the UK, US, Germany, Sweden, the Netherlands, Italy and Spain. Every year, 1.7 million pets and horses find a new home through our platforms, and our flagship platforms include Pets4Homes.co.uk, Deine-Tierwelt.de and Lancasterpuppies.com.

The pet rehoming experience has remained largely unchanged for decades. At PMG, we're on a mission to transform it by making it more trusted, safe and convenient through technology. We're a driven, ambitious team with a track record of building unicorns, backed by investors such as Verdane. We've been profitable since our first year, so we don't rely on investor capital to grow.

The opportunity

CLM is changing, and we want to rethink what it looks like when AI, automation and customer data sit at the heart of how we work. Our CRM covers email, push, in app and SMS for buyers and breeders across our marketplaces, with more markets joining as the group grows.

As our CRM & Lifecycle Manager, you'll own key parts of the customer lifecycle with our Head of CLM, across strategy, data, automation and execution. You'll spot where engagement can improve, design new journeys and experiments, and build the workflows that bring them to life.

You'll also help shape how the CLM itself works. Successful experiments become repeatable systems, and work that doesn't need a person gets automated.

Your edge is building fast and measuring everything. You use AI daily for research, analysis, segmentation, copy, personalisation and testing, so running several markets does not mean several times the work.

What you will do

  • Own the customer lifecycle. Design journeys for buyers and breeders that respond to what they do, across email, push, in app and SMS.

  • Turn data into action. Dig into behavioural data, spot opportunities and turn them into relevant experiences.

  • Automate the repetitive. Turn manual CRM processes into automated workflows, so time goes to higher value work.

  • Test what AI makes possible. Experiment with personalisation, content and segmentation, measure the results and take what works into production.

  • Build for scale. Create reusable journeys and processes, ready for new markets as the group grows.

  • Work across the business. Partner with product, data, engineering and marketing on the customer experience and the infrastructure behind it.

Requirements

Must have experience

  • 4 or more years in CRM or lifecycle marketing, preferably in house, with campaigns you personally built that moved a metric you can name. Marketplace, consumer app or ecommerce experience is a strong plus.

Job Summary

For our client, we are looking for Senior Software Engineers with strong expertise in JAVA to join a remote team developing and enhancing mission-critical software systems within the financial services industry.

In this role, you will contribute to the design, development, and maintenance of high-performance, scalable applications while collaborating with experienced engineers, architects, and business stakeholders. You will have the opportunity to influence technical decisions and work in a modern Agile environment using best software engineering practices.

You will be part of a long-term team augmentation project supporting a global investment management organization. Depending on your experience and interests, you may join one of the following engineering teams:

Execution Technology

Develop systems responsible for routing, executing, and monitoring trades across global markets, including broker and venue connectivity, order routing, trade lifecycle management, and execution analytics.

Order Management and Analytics

Build and enhance the core Order Management System (OMS), supporting the complete investment order lifecycle-from order creation and compliance checks to routing, execution, allocations, and audit trails. This area requires a strong focus on correctness, reliability, and regulatory compliance.

Enterprise Engineering

Develop and maintain shared internal platforms, APIs, CI/CD tooling, and engineering infrastructure that support multiple development teams. The focus is on scalability, reliability, automation, and improving the overall developer experience.

This is a fully remote opportunity offering the chance to work on complex, business-critical systems using modern technologies while collaborating with international engineering teams. It is an excellent opportunity for senior engineers who enjoy solving challenging technical problems, building high-quality software, and contributing to the architecture of enterprise-scale platforms.

Responsibilities:

  • Lead the end-to-end delivery of complex software solutions from requirements gathering and architecture design to development, testing, and production deployment;
  • Own and drive long-term technical initiatives and architectural improvements across systems;
  • Spotting gaps or unclear requirements early and proactively reaching out to the right teams for answers;
  • Collaborate closely with stakeholders to align technical solutions with business goals;
  • Champion engineering best practices, including CI/CD, automated testing, and scalable design patterns;
  • Balancing multiple priorities at once, new features, production issues, support requests, and releases;
  • Operating day-to-day within the project tools, codebase, infrastructure, and processes as part of the project team.

Requirements:

  • 5-7+ years of experience as a software engineer;
  • Strong experience with Java (Spring Boot), Apache Kafka, and microservices architecture;
  • Confidence navigating and contributing to large, unfamiliar codebases;
  • Solid understanding of messaging protocols and data mapping;
  • Financial services background would be considered as advantage;
  • Experience working in regulated or institutional environments;
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins or similar);
  • Comfort using AI-assisted development tools;
  • Ability to work independently and drive things forward;
  • Exelent communication skills with a proactive, speak-up mindset.

Nice to have:

  • React.js experience is a plus;
  • FIX protocol experience;
  • Experience with cloud platforms (Azure or AWS);
  • Docker/containerisation experience.

The offer:

  • Project/Client:

    Global Investment Management Firm

  • Location: Remote (Baltic States, EU)
  • ﻿﻿Language: English
  • Engagement: Full-time
  • B2B contract till the end of the year (possibility to renew)
  • Hourly rate: 30-35 EUR

Selection Process

Stage 1: CV Screening

Your application will be reviewed within 24 hours of submission.

Stage 2: Pre-Screening

A short Q/A session to assess your experience and technical background. You can choose between:

  • Automated Q/A session (recommended for faster feedback)
  • Recruiter interview

Stage 3: Shortlisting

Candidates whose experience best matches the role will be shortlisted and presented to the hiring manager.

Stage 4: Technical Interview

The technical interview process includes:

  • Technical discussion with the Team Lead (approximately 30 minutes)
  • Live coding session (approximately 60 minutes)

Non-Disclosure Agreement (NDA)

Before the technical interview, candidates will be asked to sign a Non-Disclosure Agreement (NDA), as confidential information about the end client may be discussed during the interview.

To prepare the NDA, we will request the following information:

  • Full name
  • Residential address
  • National identification number (or equivalent identification required by your country)

Stage 5: End Client Interview

Candidates who successfully complete the previous stages will proceed to the end client interview process.

This stage may include one or more interview rounds. The first interview is typically a 60 min. (live coding) + 30 min. soft-skills discussion, focusing on your technical expertise, project experience, system design approach, and problem-solving skills.

Stage 6: Offer and Onboarding

Successful candidates will receive an offer and begin the onboarding process.

As part of the onboarding process, a background verification will be conducted. Candidates will be asked to provide the following documents:

  • Criminal Record Certificate
  • Confirmation that the contractor is not subject to financial sanctions (Financial Sanctions Screening)
  • Copies of educational certificates and diplomas
  • A valid work permit for the country where the contractor resides and works (if applicable)

Once all required documentation has been received and the background verification has been successfully completed, the onboarding process can begin.

---

Additional Information

  • We recommend completing the Automated Q/A Session during the pre-screening stage, as it typically allows us to provide feedback more quickly.
  • Candidates who prefer a traditional approach may instead complete the pre-screening with one of our recruiters.
  • We aim to keep candidates informed throughout the process and provide updates after each completed stage.

About the role

As a Security Administrator I, you will support the administration, monitoring, and continuous improvement of identity and access management (IAM) processes across the organization. In this role, you will help ensure users have appropriate access to systems, applications, and data while supporting security, compliance, and audit requirements. You will work closely with business and IT teams to administer access, maintain security controls, investigate exceptions, and support identity-related initiatives.

This is an excellent opportunity for an early-career security professional looking to grow their expertise in Identity and Access Management, Information Security, and Governance.

What you will do

  • Administer and maintain user identities, access rights, security roles, and profiles across multiple applications, systems, and platforms.
  • Analyze, execute, and monitor identity and access management policies, procedures, and controls.
  • Develop and maintain end-user security access rules and profiles to ensure appropriate access is granted and maintained.
  • Create, review, and analyze access reports, investigating and resolving access-related exceptions and discrepancies.
  • Assist in the development, implementation, documentation, and ongoing maintenance of identity and access management controls and processes.
  • Perform access reviews, monitor control effectiveness, and support audit and compliance activities.
  • Provide support to business and IT teams regarding identity and access management policies, procedures, and security-related issues.
  • Educate employees and stakeholders on identity and access management best practices and security requirements.
  • Partner with internal teams, vendors, and service providers to support access administration and security initiatives.
  • Maintain accurate documentation related to access controls, user provisioning, and security processes.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to investigate and resolve access-related issues.
  • Detail-oriented with the ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining a high degree of accuracy.
  • Knowledge of information security principles, controls, and best practices.
  • Experience supporting audit, compliance, or control review activities.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to interact effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

This role will lead efforts in forecasting demand, managing inventory levels, and optimizing stock for their entire catalog of products. As a key part of the Supply Chain team, this individual will ensure that the company maintains optimal stock levels while balancing cost efficiencies and operational requirements.

About the company:

The company is specialised on developing and upscaling Amazon-based brands across the USA, Canada, Europe, and the UK. With deep expertise in eCommerce and Amazon FBA, the company excels in buying, developing, and scaling brands to their fullest potential. The company navigates the complexities of international markets and high-performance marketing, ensuring seamless scalability and growth.

The company's portfolio includes several Amazon brands, primarily in the home and kitchen category, as well as some electronics. Its international team of 17 world-class talents manages all operations today.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Demand Planning: Analyze historical sales data, current product trends, and market insights to accurately forecast demand for all products.
  • Inventory Management: Calculate and manage optimal inventory levels to ensure product availability while minimizing excess stock and associated costs.
  • Order Management: Generate purchase orders for replenishment based on forecasted demand and stock levels, collaborating with suppliers to ensure timely deliveries.
  • Stock Control & Optimization: Monitor and optimize stock levels across the catalog, ensuring products are always available in the required quantities and minimizing overstock.
  • Analytics & Reporting: Provide regular reports on demand forecasts, stock status, and key performance indicators (KPIs). Use advanced analytics to recommend inventory adjustments and supply chain improvements.
  • Cross-functional Collaboration: Work closely with brand managers, supply chain teams, and other stakeholders to align demand forecasts with marketing, promotions, and sales strategies.
  • Amazon Marketplace Management: Oversee inventory management for Amazon, ensuring accurate stock levels, fulfillment coordination, and alignment with marketplace demand trends.

Qualifications:

  • Proven experience in demand planning, inventory management, and supply chain operations, preferably in e-commerce.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret large datasets and generate actionable insights.
  • Experience managing inventory for the Amazon Marketplace, including knowledge of FBA (Fulfilled by Amazon) and related processes.
  • High attention to detail and organizational skills.
  • Experience working with international suppliers, especially from China, is a plus.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills to work effectively with cross-functional teams.
  • Proficiency in Google Spreadsheets, data analysis tools, and demand planning software
  • Experience with Inventory Planner would be a plus
  • This role is essential for maintaining efficient and cost-effective inventory management while supporting the companys growth through data-driven insights and precise demand forecasting.

What We Offer:

  • Fully remote and full-time role.
  • Paid time off.
  • Yearly bonuses.
  • Professional growth opportunities, such as managing staff members and growing your skill set.
  • Competitive and timely salary.
  • Opportunity to work remotely in an international company.
  • Dynamic, creative work environments.
  • Flexible schedule.

We are looking for a Senior Data / Ingestion Engineer for our client, a consultancy that helps banks and insurers transform their operations through AI, automation, and advanced analytics, with a strong focus on Anti-Financial Crime (fraud prevention, AML, KYC) and enterprise AI platforms. You will join their delivery for a Dutch insurance client.

We're looking for an engineer with deep experience building robust ingestion pipelines for unstructured documents and integrating OCR and document extraction technologies. You will turn high volumes of insurance documents (PDFs, scans, emails, Office files) into structured, high-quality, AI-ready data that feeds downstream RAG and AI models.

This is a long-term remote-first contract position for candidates based in Europe.

Responsibilities

  • Design and implement scalable pipelines for ingesting high-volume unstructured insurance documents (PDFs, scans, emails, Word, Excel, PowerPoint).

  • Build connectors to document sources such as SharePoint and email.

  • Integrate, configure, and optimise OCR and document parsing technologies to extract high-accuracy text and layouts.

  • Build automated workflows for text cleaning, normalisation, semantic chunking, and metadata tagging.

  • Design vector storage schemas and robust retrieval mechanisms (RAG) to feed downstream AI models.

  • Ensure document processing pipelines meet enterprise security and low-latency SLA requirements.

  • Build automated error monitoring and extraction validation loops that flag low-confidence OCR outputs.

  • Apply engineering best practices across the pipeline lifecycle: version control, CI/CD, and testing.

Work Conditions

  • Start Date: ASAP

  • Location: Remote within Europe (CEE preferred)

  • Long-term contract-based role: until July 2027 with possible extension

  • Contract with EU LCC

Requirements

  • 5–10 years' experience in data engineering.

  • Proven experience building data processing and document ingestion pipelines on public cloud platforms.

  • Hands-on experience processing unstructured documents (PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, scans, emails).

  • Experience building connectors to enterprise sources such as SharePoint and email.

  • Practical experience with document extraction / OCR tools, e.g. AWS Textract or equivalent.

  • Strong engineering practices: Git, CI/CD, automated testing.

  • Experience in banking or insurance is an advantage.

Technical Requirements

Mandatory

  • Python, SQL

  • AWS: S3, Step Functions, CloudWatch

  • OCR / document extraction: AWS Textract or equivalent

  • Unstructured document processing and ingestion pipelines

  • Git, CI/CD, testing

Nice to have

  • Vector databases and RAG architectures

  • Azure, Databricks

  • Financial services / insurance domain experience

Highlights

If you are passionate about turning unstructured documents into AI-ready data, and want to help leading financial institutions fight financial crime with AI, this role is for you!
